global_rules.synthetic_media: If AI-generated talent, voice, or heavily synthetic footage is used, set disclosure flags in the output package. Prefer platform-native disclosure tools when available; otherwise on-screen/caption disclosure. Never hide synthetic identity as a real customer testimonial.

rights_decision_tree.q: Is the audio a trending commercial song?
rights_decision_tree.if_yes: Organic-only unless explicitly cleared for paid. Paid twin uses Suno/original/licensed bed.

rights_decision_tree.q: Are faces of real people shown?
rights_decision_tree.if_yes: Need release / owned UGC rights / employee consent. Else use AI talent + disclosure or B-roll without faces.

rights_decision_tree.q: Is proof a review or metric?
rights_decision_tree.if_yes: Must be user-supplied. Else [PLACEHOLDER] or omit.
Prefer 'old way' framing; avoid illegal trademark smear.
Only user-approved language; add compliance line; no guarantees.

tiktok.captions: Burned-in or native; huge hook text; native slang OK
tiktok.synthetic_disclosure: Use platform disclosure when available; caption 'AI-generated' if synthetic talent presents as person
tiktok.notes: Native > polished. Muted must work. Spark for creator codes.

meta.captions: Assume muted; safe zones for UI chrome
meta.synthetic_disclosure: Follow Meta AI/synthetic advertising policies; disclose when required; never fake testimonials
meta.notes: Message match to landing is critical.

youtube.synthetic_disclosure: Disclose synthetic content per YouTube/Google ads policies when applicable

youtube_shorts.synthetic_disclosure: Same family as TikTok-native short form
youtube_shorts.notes: Treat like TikTok with stronger search.

pinterest.synthetic_disclosure: Disclose when lifestyle talent is synthetic

influencer_seed.synthetic_disclosure: Real creators preferred; if AI influencer, disclose
